proof_body:
by
  intro x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃
  have hP : 0 ≤ (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (x₂ - x₃) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₃) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hdot : (x₁ - x₂) * (x₂ - x₃) + (y₁ - y₂) * (y₂ - y₃) ≤ Real.sqrt ((x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2) * Real.sqrt ((x₂ - x₃) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₃) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hP]
    refine Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le ?_
    linarith [sq_nonneg ((x₁ - x₂) * (y₂ - y₃) - (y₁ - y₂) * (x₂ - x₃))]
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
  have e₁ := Real.sq_sqrt hP
  have e₂ := Real.sq_sqrt hQ
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ : ℝ), Real.sqrt ((x₁ - x₃) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₃) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2) + Real.sqrt ((x₂ - x₃) ^ 2 + (y₂ - y₃) ^ 2)
